findings.title: Impossible calendar dates and 24:00 are accepted and rolled over
findings.why: `parseInstant` checks only a regex shape and `Date.parse`, which does not reject some impossible dates in V8. `2026-02-30T00:00:00Z` is read as 2 March, and `T24:00:00Z` as the next midnight. So `quote`, `book`, `availability` and `cancel` accept inputs the spec calls invalid and reserve or refund on a different date than the one given. A round-trip check, `new Date(ms).toISOString()` compared with the input, would reject these.
